description: Lender league table — ranks lenders by SBA loan count and total dollar volume. For 7(a) loans "lender" is the originating bank; for 504 loans it is the CDC (Certified Development Company) that books the debenture. Answers "which bank does the most SBA lending in NAICS Y" or "top SBA 504 lenders in California".

program.description: Optional: "7A" or "504". Omit to combine both (note: 7(a) banks and 504 CDCs are different kinds of entity, so combining programs mixes those populations).

name: sba_lender_league_table
title: Sba Lender League Table
